parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-08 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 225.6 | 4.98 | 4.98
2 | 217.6 | 7.63 | 12.61
3 | 626.8 | 19.10 | 31.71
4 | 694.3 | 0.32 | 32.03
5 | 580.5 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-08
Curve type: HK-type
Aquifer depth: 4.98 – 12.61 m (secondary potential zone below 32.03 m)
Recommendation: The low-resistivity zone (217.6 ohm-m) between 4.98 m and 12.61 m is interpreted as the primary water-bearing horizon; plan main screen placement within this interval and case off the overlying layer to prevent collapse. If yield from this zone is insufficient, consider deepening the borehole past 32.03 m to test the underlying lower-resistivity basement (580.5 ohm-m), which may represent a fractured/weathered secondary aquifer.
